pillars.scenario:
You are one of our talented IMs, intimately familiar with our Adyen Checkout solution. You've been assigned to a project and will lead a technical kick off call with the merchant [Merchant Name], which we've been trying to poach from our competitor for years.

You've aligned with the Adyen commercial Sales Manager [Sales Manager Name] on high level topics and now the Sales Manager & [Merchant Name] team has invited their CTO, [CTO Name], a technically gifted person who is slow to warm up to new partners, to learn about Adyen's integration and integration process. Your commercial colleague has primed the team and has them excited about Adyen.

We have just found out the CTO has invited members of their technical team to the meeting, including their developer, [Developer Name], who will be in charge of integrating Adyen and the merchants Project Manager [Project Manager Name]. Their developer is a highly technical and organised individual who has worked with the merchants previous PSP before and the Project Manager is an experienced Project Manager who will be managing the project from the merchants side.

You're expected to lead the call and:
- Uncover the merchant's unique business needs
- Present yourself as a subject matter expert
- Explain and set expectations for Adyen's way of implementing and what can be achieved in the timeline
- Give a technical presentation about our Adyen Ecommerce proposition tailored using the information you uncover
- Close the meeting on time and with immediate next steps for the integration, as well as send a Kick off summary email afterward that also covers any outstanding questions.

Your commercial colleague has informed you that the attendees are very detail oriented and will also have some minor questions on the Adyen Platform / tokenisation / acquiring / financial reconciliation amongst other topics, so be ready for some off-track questions. There will be a separate POS meeting so no need to know everything about that, but some general knowledge might be useful.

The [Merchant Name] team has 1 hour available, so make sure you condense your talking points to the important topics you want to convey. They look forward to understanding how our solution works and what they can achieve with Adyen. Attached is the Roll out plan we have received from the Sales Manager [Sales Manager Name].

questions.text: Did the candidate inquire about the merchant’s current flow or process?
questions.desc3: Has researched merchant and can explain understanding of merchants user and payment flows
questions.desc5: Can proactively walk team through all the merchants shopper flows & ones they have researched. Askes questions on if there is more not uncovered.

questions.text: Did the candidate ask, set and manage expectations for the meeting? Do they clearly set boundaries for their role vs sales for example?
questions.desc3: Starts meeting with Intro & agenda for meeting. No pre comms. Any commercial objections are referenced to SM
questions.desc5: Before meeting, a welcome email with agenda for meeting and intro to self & relevant pre reads and ask for questions they already have. Incl proactive statement about commercial topics being directed to SM

questions.text: Did candidate ensure most critical items were covered in Agenda and anything missed is followed up?
questions.desc3: Able to bring meeting back on track, handle objections that could delay agenda and offer solutions to address non agenda items.
questions.desc5: Same as Average but also offers deep dive sessions on topics, provides clear documentation and follow ups and is able to retain merchants confidence.

questions.text: Did the candidate show they had done their research on the merchants industry, competitors and business?
questions.desc3: Show basic understanding of merchant and virtuical in region.
questions.desc5: Shows in depth understanding merchant & vertical and comes prepared with assumptions and work flows for confirmation

questions.text: Did the candidate provide the correct Adyen doc links for all relevant points discussed and clear answers to follow up questions?
questions.desc3: Documented scope, provides relevant docs and answers to follow up questions. Suggests ongoing project meetings.
questions.desc5: Is thinking ahead and providing answers and info for questions the merchant has not yet asked for. Proactively offers deep dives to topics the most important to the merchant.

questions.text: Did the candidate give proper advice on which integration would suit the merchant scenario best and pivot appropriately?
questions.desc3: Confidently recommend options based on scoped info.
questions.desc5: Able to explain the why & justifacation behind recommendations and handle objecions to this recommendation.

questions.text: Did the candidate give a proper explanation of the flow of data between the server and client?
questions.desc3: Used standard doc slides and covers topline information
questions.desc5: Able to explain in detail and the effect it has on the merchant & implications (eg. PCI scope etc)

questions.text: Did the candidate present the different ecom integration options?
questions.desc3: Run through standard doc page/slide deck and talks to standard demo
questions.desc5: Candidate uses the integration they built themselves to demo during the meeting

questions.text: Did the candidate give a proper explanation on 3DS?
questions.desc3: Explains the need for 3DS and topline info
questions.desc5: Able to discuss different flows and impact & recommendation for merchant.

questions.text: Did the candidate give a proper explanation of tokenization, what a token is made up of, and the different processing models?
questions.desc3: Explains what tokenisation is, apprpriate use cases and how to technically implement this correctly.
questions.desc5: Able to discuss different flows and impact & recommendation for merchant.

questions.text: Did the candidate give a proper explanation of payment modifications and webhooks?
questions.desc3: Able to explain the different modifications, types of webhooks and use cases.
questions.desc5:
Able to explain the different modifications, types of webhooks and use cases.
Can make sticky for the merchant and specifically recommend use cases for their business and in context of their implementation.

questions.desc3: Were able to handle most objections on the spot and acknowledged the need for follow up.
questions.desc5: Able to handle ALL objections and show authority to merchant on all topics and recommendations.

questions.desc5: Show agility in their approach, able to handle objections professionally. Able to admit to not having answers and show follow up. Also able to find answers on the spot.

questions.desc3: Recaps meeting & top line next steps. Suggests ongoing cadence.
questions.desc5:
Recaps meeting & top line next steps. Suggests ongoing cadence.
Offers next meeting time on call

questions.desc3: Refers back to standard docs and slides (resources) to support explanation.
questions.desc5: Clear articulation and able to on the spot whiteboard and explain reasoning and technical concepts. Able to cater language to less technical audiences.
